title: Rabbi Natan, an Amora
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Vayikra Rabbah 21:5 mentions him together with Rabbi Acha, both reporting Rabbi Simon. In Bereshit Rabbah 5:8 he reports Rabbi Acha.
Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 7:1 mentions Rabbi Natan explaining Natan bar Hoshaya’s reasoning. Hyman infers that he belonged to the fourth generation of Amoraim in the Land of Israel.

notes.text: Hyman’s fourth-generation placement is an inference. Explaining Natan bar Hoshaya’s reason does not itself identify the reporting Natan with him.
